title: Rapid Acting Mental Health Treatment: Los Angeles 2025
subtitle: I am so excited to announce the next live-action newsletter event!
body_html:
Years back, I had the pleasure of attending “live-action” versions of Radiolab and Planet Money here in Brooklyn. On-stage podcasts, particularly those about science and economics, are very close to peak-nerdy entertainment. However, I dare postulate that live-action newsletters might be even closer to the summit of Mt. Nerd. Here at The Frontier Psychiatrists, we have a recurring live event called “Rapid Acting Mental Health Treatment.” It was co-created with my friend Grady Hannah—a ride-or-die friend if ever there was one!

As of now, there are two of these events per year—one held alongside JPM Health in San Francisco and the other following the location of the American Psychiatric Association Annual Meeting. We’ve had three events thus far, and the fourth is inbound. I dare say it’s got the most exciting lineup to date.

The next is May 18th, 2025, in Los Angeles.

It’s held at the swanky Skyline Loft at 224 East 11th Street #601 Los Angeles, CA 90015.

Get your RAMHT Tickets Now!

Yes, that is when the APA is in town. Yes, I have to book the airline tickets myself.

The point of these events was to take a conceit—fast-paced discussions about treatments and tools that challenge our conceptions of what is possible in mental health care.

Our speakers include:

  • Grady Hannah, Co-Founder, Executive Team Member, Attentio AI, Co-Founder NightWare

  • Kellie Newsome, NP, co-host Carlat Psychiatry Podcast

  • Carlene MacMillan, M.D., DFAACAP, FCTMSS, Chief Product Officer at Radial

  • Daniel Karlin, M.D. Chief Medical Officer, MindMed

  • Jay Sanguinetti, Ph.D., Founder and President, Sanm.ai

  • Sandhya Prashad, M.D., Medical Director Houston Ketamine Therapeutics & Houston Deep TMS Therapy, President at American Society of Ketamine Physicians

  • Sarah Norman, Executive Director, BrainFutures . Former CMS

  • Chris Aiken, M.D., Director, Psych Partners. Editor of The Carlat Report

  • Oded Kraft, Co-founder, CEO and President at GrayMatters Health

  • Dominik Middelmann, Co-Founder & CEO MDHub

  • Jonathan Seltzer, CEO SimplePractice

  • Jonathan Downar, MD, Co-Founder, Ampa Health

  • Chris Dougherty, Founder and Chief Strategist at Hydra Strategies

Here are some clips from our last event in January! First, Chris Aiken takes on Stigma…

Then, Eric Vanderhoef tackles payor and health provider relationships…

We keep it brief and spicy! It will be the most exciting RAMHT event to date.

Join us! For those keeping track, yes, it’s in the evening while the American Psychiatric Association is in town!

Thanks for reading, and I hope you can join us for a bracing evening of fast paced conversations.

The Frontier Psychiatrists is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
